exclusions_and_limitations: UK residents aged 18 or over only; employee, immediate-family, agent and professional exclusions apply (Wren clause 1).
Graded, seconds, replacement and imperfect products excluded (Wren clause 14).
One claim per eligible appliance; no other promoter offer combination unless allowed (Wren clauses 9 and 15).
Returned appliances are ineligible; paid cashback must be reimbursed (Wren clause 20).
Bank transfer follows claim validation; payment is not proof of purchase eligibility (Wren clause 16).
Internet access and email required; claimant must use full legal name (Wren clauses 7 and 10).

requirements.description: Retain and upload receipt showing Wren, product model and purchase date (Wren clauses 5 and 8(c)).
Provide product model and serial number when claiming (Wren clause 8(c)).
Register appliance warranty and provide registration confirmation (Wren clauses 6 and 8(b)/(c)).

limitations: Test-only reference for H7IC16M6 UK purchased directly from Wren; other models and retailers are not assessed.

The 30-day wait after purchase is unmodelled: the fixed-only window can produce false-positive ELIGIBLE results before the individual wait elapses. No production publication or general claim-now promise is permitted until a purchase-relative opening plus fixed absolute deadline is supported.

The five-field request does not verify residency, age, employee exclusions, condition, Wren seller, registration, receipt, serial, prior claims, offer combination, returns or banking details. Requirements are claim steps, not satisfied user facts.
Dates are inclusive UK calendar dates; sub-day 00:00/23:59 cutoffs are not enforced. Hotpoint makes the final claim decision; this result does not guarantee approval or payment.
